title: COGTRL: Training LLMs for Scientific Discovery Assistance using Cognitive Traces via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) trained on extensive scientific research are increasingly integrated as assistants for scientific discovery. However, most research papers omit the fine-grained cognitive process of examining constraints, failed alternatives, and iterative decisions required to achieve the desired goal. Such cognitive processes are vital for real-world scientists working toward specific goals under constraints. In this paper, we show that LLMs, when trained to produce such cognitive traces, perform better as scientific discovery assistants than when trained solely on scientific literature. We propose COGTRL, a trajectory-level reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to emulate cognitively grounded reasoning by jointly optimizing cognitive traces and the scientific steps produced in an interleaved manner. translated_title: COGTRL：通过强化学习利用认知轨迹训练大语言模型以辅助科学发现
translated_abstract: 基于大量科学研究数据训练的大语言模型（LLMs）正日益被整合为科学发现的助手。然而，大多数研究论文省略了实现目标所需的细粒度认知过程，包括审视约束条件、尝试失败的替代方案以及迭代决策。这些认知过程对于在约束条件下朝特定目标努力的现实世界科学家而言至关重要。在本文中，我们表明，当训练LLM生成此类认知轨迹时，它们作为科学发现助手的表现优于仅基于科学文献训练的模型。我们提出了COGTRL，这是一个轨迹级强化学习框架，通过联合优化认知轨迹和以交错方式生成的科学步骤，训练LLM模拟基于认知的推理过程。在两个30亿参数模型和两个科学领域（人工智能和材料科学）上，COGTRL提升了方法质量……
tldr: 本文提出COGTRL轨迹级强化学习框架，通过联合优化认知轨迹与科学步骤来训练大语言模型模拟科学家的认知推理过程，使其作为科学发现助手的表现优于仅用科学文献训练的模型。
en_tdlr: COGTRL is a trajectory-level reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to emulate scientists' cognitive reasoning by jointly optimizing cognitive traces and interleaved scientific steps, making them better scientific discovery assistants than models trained solely on scientific literature.
